title: Academic poster: Impact of Different Factors on Hyporheic Exchange in a Meandering Pool-riffle Stream
objects_and_counts: One large printed academic poster mounted as a single panel visible in the photograph.
The poster is arranged in three vertical columns (left column, central column, right column).
No people are visible in the photographed scene.
Multiple schematic diagrams, plots and coloured contour maps are visible across the three columns (individual diagram count not precisely determinable from this view).

At least six photographic image inserts are visible: a small schematic/photo near the top left labelled Fig. 1, two small landscape photographs in the left column under the introduction, a photo labelled Fig. 4 in the lower left showing an experimental setup, and two landscape photos in the lower right column (one larger and one smaller) labelled Fig. 11.
One rectangular title/header band spans the top of the poster with institutional logo at top-left.
Several labelled figure boxes with small numbered captions are visible throughout (e.g., Fig. 5, Fig. 6, Fig. 7, Fig. 8, Fig. 9, Fig. 10 appear in the centre and right columns).

spatial_relations: A wide blue header band runs across the top of the poster with the main title centred; the departmental line and author names are immediately below the title within the header area.

The poster content is divided into three vertical columns: the left column holds 'I. Introduction' and 'II. Methodology' material with several small figures and photos; the central column is headed 'III. Results' with coloured contour maps and 3D flow path diagrams stacked vertically; the right column contains impact plots (three stacked sections addressing Q, S, qg) and a 'IV. Benefits' panel with landscape photographs near the lower right.

Figure numbers and boxed figure panels are arranged sequentially down each column (e.g., Fig. 5 appears in the central upper region, Figs. 6 and 7 in the center lower region; Figs. 8–10 are grouped in the right column above the Benefits section).
Photographic images in the left column are adjacent to explanatory text paragraphs; the Fig. 4 experimental photo sits near the bottom of the left column above the numerical simulation bullet list.
The 'WOW!' and 'River Restoration' graphic appears in the right column above the two landscape photos (Fig. 11) and a pale banner graphic separates the benefits header from the photos.
colours_and_materials: The top header band is dark blue with white title text.
Background of the poster panels appears off-white or very light cream with blue section headers in each content block.
Many plots and contour maps use bright spectral colours (red, orange, yellow, green, blue) to show elevation/flow patterns.
Photographs show green landscape vegetation and natural colours; the experimental-setup photograph shows metallic and wooden tones and electronic equipment with dark casings.
Printed paper or poster-stock mounted on a board is the evident material for the poster surface.
uncertainties: Several small figure captions and fine-grained labels are present but not fully legible at this resolution; only larger headings and many figure labels could be transcribed.

The spelling of 'Stonehadl' in Fig. 1 was transcribed as visible but may be partially unreadable or incorrect in the original; source shows 'Stonehadi et al., 2010' may have been intended but characters are not fully clear.

Exact counts of diagrams, small plots and minor photographic inserts are not determinable with high confidence from this image; I report reliably that three vertical columns exist and list visibly labelled major figures but do not assert a precise total for all small panels.
No visible room name or room number appears on the poster or surrounding area; location is therefore reported as unknown from the image.
Small labels on equipment shown in the experimental-setup photo (Fig. 4) are not legible enough to transcribe brand names, model numbers or detailed labels.

Some short text lines within plot axes, legends and small figure insets are unreadable at this image resolution and have not been transcribed (they were omitted rather than risking mis-transcription).
